questions.question: Which index is the CTC blank symbol in the lesson's VOCAB?
options: The final vocabulary index
It has no index
questions.explanation: VOCAB starts with '_' at index zero, followed by digits and lowercase letters.

questions.question: What shape does TinyCRNN.forward return for a batch of N line images?
options: (N,1,H,W), the input image reconstructed
(T,N,V), log probabilities over the vocabulary at each time
(N,V,T,H), one class map per pixel
(V,N), one token for the whole batch
questions.explanation: The CNN features are arranged as batch-time-feature, the bidirectional LSTM runs with batch_first, and the head is transposed to CTC's time-batch-class layout.

questions.question: What does greedy_ctc_decode do with repeated non-blank IDs such as [3,3,0,4]?
options: Produces [3,3,0,4] unchanged
Sorts the IDs numerically to [0,3,3,4]
Collapses the repeat and blank to produce [3,4]
Drops only the final ID
questions.explanation: CTC decoding emits an ID only when it differs from the previous ID and is not blank, so repeated characters are collapsed.

questions.question: Why does build_batch return target_lengths separately from the concatenated targets tensor?
options: The lengths are used as image channel counts
They tell the CNN how many filters to create
CTC ignores the target IDs and uses only lengths
CTC needs each string's length to split the flattened target sequence for the batch
questions.explanation: The targets are concatenated into one vector, while target_lengths tells F.ctc_loss where each example's target ends.

questions.question: What does ctc_loss's zero_infinity=True protect against?
options: It replaces infinite losses from impossible alignments with zero instead of propagating infinity
It makes every character probability exactly zero
It removes the blank symbol from the vocabulary
It forces input and target lengths to be identical
questions.explanation: The option prevents an invalid alignment from poisoning optimization with an infinite loss; it does not change the sequence model's vocabulary.

questions.question: Which stages distinguish OCR from broader document understanding?
options: OCR only detects boxes, while document understanding only changes image colors
OCR reads text, layout parsing locates structure, and understanding interprets fields or meaning
Layout parsing replaces recognition, so no text decoder is needed
All three tasks are identical pixel classifications
questions.explanation: A document system may need detection, character recognition, spatial layout, and semantic interpretation; each answers a different question.
